overview.summary:
On 14th March 2025 at approximately 10:15 AM, a high-pressure natural gas release occurred during hot work m

damages.property_damage_cost: Property Damage Cost: INR 45 Lakhs (equipment replacement and line repair)
damages.environmental_impact: Minimal ground impact; localized gas dispersion.

findings.content: Hot work (welding and grinding) commenced within 3 meters of pressurized natural gas flange.
Combustible gas detector was uncalibrated and continuous atmospheric monitoring was not performed.
Energy isolation tagout (LOTO) valve V-102 was partially passing gas due to worn seal.
Emergency Shutdown (ESD) valve at upstream terminal took 14 minutes to activate manually.

root_causes.content: Primary Cause: Inadequate Permit-to-Work (PTW) verification and failure to enforce Energy Isolation.
Underlying Cause: Deficient pre-job safety risk assessment (JSA) for hot work near active pipeline.
Management Lapses: Ineffective contractor safety supervision during turnarounds.
